title: The last English buttons
changes: The previous and next buttons at the foot of each story section now name the section in Hebrew, as do Presentation, Catalog and Local database in the sidebar.

The translation catalog now finds English printed straight into a component — text that never reaches a dictionary at all. That is what had been hiding these buttons: the Hebrew existed, but the markup never asked for it.
Signing in and out, the version panel, the worked-example panel and the Story Studio name itself are wired up too.
